tabs.title: Scenario
tabs.content:
**TerraBound Energy** is a renewable energy provider with remote monitoring stations. They want to modernize their server management using Azure Arc-enabled servers.

**Management Goals:**
- Use the Azure portal to manage both Azure VMs and on-premises Windows Servers.
- Implement consistent patching and compliance policies across all servers using Azure Automation Update Management.
- Enable secure remote access to on-premises servers using Windows Admin Center in the Azure portal.
